name: acad-hatches
description: Draw, manage and regenerate hatches (material fills) on architectural and engineering drawings per ISO 128 and PN-EN patterns. Covers boundary-based hatching, pattern presets (concrete/brick/insulation/plaster/stone), material-to-layer mapping, and regeneration after boundary edits.

tools_summary.name: apply_material_preset
tools_summary.description: Apply a named material preset (e.g. 'concrete', 'brick', 'insulation', 'plaster', 'stone', 'steel', 'glass', 'wood-cross', 'wood-grain', 'lead-shield', 'faraday', 'earth', 'tile', 'reinforced-concrete') to the supplied boundary handles. Each preset maps material -> (pattern, scale, angle, color) per rule 62-hatching-policy.

tools_summary.name: apply_material_preset_by_point
tools_summary.description: Same as apply_material_preset but takes a seed point instead of boundary handles. Auto-detects enclosing boundary, then applies the material preset. Preferred for batch populating walls/floors once the geometry is in place.

tools_summary.name: clip_hatch
tools_summary.description: Replace the boundary of an existing hatch with a new set of closed polyline/region handles. Use after editing geometry so the hatch follows the new edges. Returns the re-evaluated hatch.

tools_summary.name: draw_hatch
tools_summary.description: Fill one or more closed boundaries (identified by handle) with a named hatch pattern. Supports pattern/scale/angle, layer override, foreground+background colors, associative/annotative modes. Preferred over geometry-2d draw_hatch when you need color or background.

tools_summary.name: draw_hatch_by_boundary
tools_summary.description: Fill the closed region enclosing the given seed point, auto-detecting the boundary using AutoCAD's TraceBoundary (with optional island detection). Ideal when you only know a point inside a room rather than its edges.

tools_summary.name: list_hatches
tools_summary.description: Enumerate all hatch entities currently in model-space (optionally filtered by layer and/or pattern). Returns handle, layer, pattern, scale, angle, area, loop-count, associativity for each. Read-only.

tools_summary.name: list_patterns
tools_summary.description: Enumerate available hatch patterns with their category (ANSI, ISO, AR-architectural, PN-EN) and recommended default scale/angle. Read-only. Use to discover what patterns are installed before drawing.

tools_summary.name: regenerate_hatches
tools_summary.description: Re-evaluate one or more associative hatches after their boundaries have been edited. Scope: explicit handles, layer filter, or entire model-space. Returns the count of successfully regenerated hatches plus a list of handles that failed (e.g. open boundaries).
